Want a portrait like this? Just copy the prompt, add your reference image, and generate it with your favorite AI tool.

Created with @grok 
prompt :
Create a premium, ultra-realistic luxury fashion editorial portrait using the PROVIDED PERSON REFERENCE IMAGE as the STRICT IDENTITY REFERENCE.

IMPORTANT IDENTITY INSTRUCTION:

The provided reference image controls the identity of the main person ONLY.

Preserve the person's recognizable facial identity with maximum accuracy:

- facial structure

- face shape

- eyes and eye shape

- eyebrows

- nose

- lips

- jawline

- cheekbones

- skin tone

- hairstyle

- hair color

- hair texture

- natural facial proportions

- approximate age

- distinctive facial characteristics

DO NOT replace the person's face.

DO NOT create a generic model.

DO NOT beautify the face into a different person.

DO NOT change the person's identity.

If the provided reference is a WOMAN, create the female version of this exact editorial composition.

If the provided reference is a MAN, naturally adapt the clothing and styling to the male subject while keeping the same overall visual concept, layout, photography style and editorial composition.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

EXACT VISUAL CONCEPT

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Recreate the PROVIDED TARGET IMAGE as a high-end luxury fashion editorial portrait / magazine-style social media campaign image.

Create ONE central full-body / three-quarter-length main portrait of the reference person standing confidently in the foreground.

The main subject should be positioned in the CENTER of the composition and appear larger than the surrounding background portraits.

The subject is standing naturally with a confident relaxed posture.

One hand is placed casually inside a trouser pocket while the other arm rests naturally beside the body.

Create an elegant, sophisticated, effortless expression:

calm confident gaze directly toward the camera,

subtle natural smile,

strong but approachable presence.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MAIN OUTFIT

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Recreate the target's fashion styling:

Elegant oversized light blush-pink / dusty-rose button-up shirt,

soft lightweight fabric,

slightly loose relaxed fit,

long sleeves casually rolled toward the forearms,

natural fabric folds and wrinkles.

High-waisted tailored black trousers,

wide/relaxed elegant silhouette,

premium luxury fabric,

clean sophisticated tailoring.

Layer several delicate minimalist necklaces around the neck.

Add a classic elegant luxury wristwatch on the wrist.

Place stylish dark sunglasses naturally on top of the person's head.

The clothing must look physically realistic with:

accurate fabric texture,

natural folds,

realistic stitching,

subtle highlights,

natural shadows,

premium fashion-editorial finish.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HAIR & BEAUTY

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Keep the exact hairstyle and hair identity from the provided reference wherever possible.

Hair should look naturally voluminous and slightly flowing,

with individual realistic strands,

soft natural movement,

premium editorial grooming.

Natural realistic skin texture,

visible subtle pores,

realistic lips,

natural eyebrows,

natural eyelashes,

no plastic skin,

no excessive retouching.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

BACKGROUND COLLAGE

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a sophisticated monochrome photographic collage behind the main subject.

The background consists of MULTIPLE large black-and-white portrait photographs of the SAME PERSON from the provided reference image.

Arrange approximately FIVE surrounding portrait panels around the central subject:

TOP LEFT:

A black-and-white portrait of the same person looking slightly toward the side with a calm editorial expression.

TOP RIGHT:

A black-and-white portrait of the same person wearing sunglasses, looking confidently toward the camera / slightly upward.

MIDDLE LEFT:

A black-and-white intimate portrait of the same person with eyes gently closed, relaxed and elegant.

MIDDLE RIGHT:

A black-and-white portrait of the same person looking toward the camera from a slight side angle.

BOTTOM / LOWER BACKGROUND:

Additional monochrome editorial portrait(s) of the same person with a natural fashion pose.

Every background portrait must clearly represent THE SAME PERSON as the main foreground subject.

Maintain strong identity consistency across every portrait.

The background portraits must remain monochrome black-and-white / grayscale while the central foreground portrait remains naturally colored.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

COLLAGE DESIGN

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use rounded rectangular photographic panels arranged in a clean modern collage.

The panels should have:

- rounded corners

- subtle spacing between panels

- clean editorial arrangement

- soft photographic borders

- consistent grayscale treatment

The central colored subject should visually overlap the surrounding monochrome panels.

Add a subtle clean WHITE CUTOUT / PAPER-COLLAGE OUTLINE around the main foreground person, approximately 5–15 pixels visually, separating the subject from the background.

The white outline should follow the natural silhouette of the person and create the premium magazine cutout effect visible in the target image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TEXT DESIGN

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Add elegant editorial typography in the lower-left area of the composition.

Small uppercase text:

"CONFIDENCE IS SILENT"

Large bold stacked typography:

"ELEGANCE"

"IS LOUD."

Smaller supporting editorial text underneath:

"STAY FOCUSED."

"STAY HUMBLE."

"KEEP GLOWING."

Typography should be:

clean,

bold,

modern,

fashion-magazine inspired,

white,

properly aligned,

highly legible.

DO NOT add any other text.

DO NOT add logos,

watermarks,

brand names,

random letters,

or unrelated typography.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PHOTOGRAPHY

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Ultra-realistic professional fashion photography.

Luxury editorial campaign aesthetic.

Natural realistic skin.

High facial detail.

Detailed hair strands.

Realistic clothing texture.

Natural shadows.

Subtle depth of field.

Professional studio-quality exposure.

Premium lens rendering.

Soft cinematic lighting.

The central subject should be sharply focused.

Background portraits should have slightly softer photographic detail while remaining clearly recognizable.

Use realistic photographic depth and layering so the central person feels physically positioned in front of the collage.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LIGHTING

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Soft diffused studio lighting.

Gentle frontal key light.

Subtle side fill.

Natural facial shadows.

Soft highlights on skin and hair.

Realistic shadow underneath the subject.

Clean premium fashion-campaign illumination.

Avoid harsh artificial lighting.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

COLOR GRADING

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Central subject:

natural warm realistic skin tones,

soft blush-pink clothing,

deep black trousers,

natural hair color.

Background:

strict black-and-white / grayscale photography.

Overall:

minimal,

clean,

luxurious,

modern,

editorial,

sophisticated.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CAMERA & COMPOSITION

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Straight-on eye-level camera.

Centered composition.

Main subject occupies approximately 55–65% of the image height.

Full-body or near-full-body fashion portrait.

Keep the complete person visible whenever possible.

Natural perspective.

No fisheye distortion.

No extreme wide-angle distortion.

Premium fashion magazine composition.

Strong foreground/background separation.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IDENTITY CONSISTENCY

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The SAME PERSON from the provided reference image must appear in:

1. the main central colored portrait

2. top-left background portrait

3. top-right background portrait

4. middle-left background portrait

5. middle-right background portrait

6. lower background portrait(s)

All versions must maintain the same recognizable facial identity.

Do not mix identities between panels.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

QUALITY

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Hyper-realistic.

Photorealistic.

Ultra-detailed.

Luxury editorial photography.

Premium magazine-cover quality.

Extremely detailed facial features.

Natural skin pores.

Realistic hair strands.

Realistic fabric.

Accurate anatomy.

Professional photographic rendering.

TARGET OUTPUT:

16K ULTRA HIGH RESOLUTION

15360 × 8640 pixels

approximately 132.7 million pixels.

If the image-generation model cannot natively generate 15360 × 8640 pixels, generate at the highest available resolution while preserving maximum detail and composition, specifically optimized for high-quality 16K upscaling.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

NEGATIVE PROMPT

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

different person, changed identity, identity drift, generic model, face replacement, face swap, altered facial structure, different eyes, different nose, different lips, different hairstyle, different skin tone, inconsistent face, duplicate identity, multiple different people, distorted face, bad anatomy, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed hands, unrealistic body proportions, plastic skin, wax skin, CGI, 3D render, cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, blurry face, low detail, low resolution, oversharpened skin, excessive retouching, unrealistic hair, distorted sunglasses, malformed clothing, messy collage, colorful background portraits, random background people, unreadable text, misspelled typography, random letters, logos, watermark, signature, cropped head, cropped feet, fisheye lens, extreme perspective, artificial expression.

Did a deep-dive on where local AI actually stands right now. The last ~3 months of releases, benchmarks and hardware, in one post. No vibes — just numbers.

━━ THE MODELS (what people are actually running)

Qwen3.8-27B — the star of the quarter. Scored 52 on the Artificial Analysis index, the same level as DeepSeek V4-Pro and GPT-5.6 Luna. First local model to hit frontier-class scores. Unsloth's dynamic quants fit it in 17GB. Every tier from a 24GB 3090 to a 32GB 5090 runs it. Uncensored, agentic and abliterated variants are everywhere.
→ https://t.co/jYAbkeBxLE

DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 — the 304B MoE that owns the 128GB tier. On 2x DGX Sparks: near-Opus quality, 75–89 tok/s, 1M+ verified context. V4.1-Flash just rolled out (Sept 11) and it's trending again.
→ https://t.co/lx0brZh6ag

Kimi K3 — launched July 22, crashed Moonshot's servers so hard they paused signups for 48h. At 1-bit it runs on a MacBook Pro and people still can't believe it. K2.8 Preview dropped this week.
→ https://t.co/6M4pAyWPZ6

Gemma 4 (12B / 26B-A4B / 31B) — the small & edge tier king. 12B does text+image+audio in 8GB VRAM. 26B-A4B = "infinite free ChatGPT" for coding.
→ https://t.co/Rq9hwr25A2
→ https://t.co/3XTxNpGxuT

The heavy hitters:

Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B — 4.9TB → 397GB at 1-bit, "rivals GPT-5.6 Sol"
→ https://t.co/Cs8QFgRV3Z

GLM-5.3
→ https://t.co/Ahqbt5Hqvo

→ https://t.co/kPFXCU85rs

→ https://t.co/drGxL0D9ah

→ https://t.co/lR1SOomFIQ

→ https://t.co/IiSBWkDEpr

→ https://t.co/teUEoUfr7O

gpt-oss-120b — still the default "big open model". GPT-OSS-2 is long overdue.
→ https://t.co/wrSI0Z9pN5

━━ THE HARDWARE (tiers + real street prices)

8–16GB — laptops, 4060 Ti, 5060: Gemma-4-12B Q4, gpt-oss-20b. Entry point, and it's actually good now.

24GB — used 3090 ($1,100–2,000) / 4090 ($2,099–4,499). Still the LARGEST base in the scene. Runs Qwen3.8-27B 8-bit, DS-R1-32B, Ornith 35B at 115+ tok/s. The 5080+3090 hybrid is huge in Japan (80+ tok/s for way less).

32GB — 5090: $3,599–5,199 street (AI demand + RAM price surge pushed it way past MSRP). Qwen3.8-27B at 132K context, ~60 tok/s. Real security research is being done on these.

96GB — RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell. "If you want to be serious, this is the only choice." 4x96GB builds are the enthusiast peak.

128GB unified — the new frontier:
• NVIDIA DGX Spark: $3,999 → hiked to $4,699 in months. 2x = 256GB = "the frontier at home." Plus a whole clone war: HP ZGX, Acer GN100, MSI EdgeXpert, Lenovo PGX, Gigabyte AI TOP, Dell Pro Max — same GB10 silicon.
• AMD's counterpunch: Strix Halo / Ryzen AI Halo boxes at $1,999–3,999. GMKtec EVO-X2 (128GB) ≈ $2,000. Half the price of a Spark, ~90% of the performance.
• Apple (Aug 25): Mac mini M6 from $899 (up to 32GB, 2nm — the new $3/month home AI server). Mac Studio M5 Ultra from ~$7,500, up to 512GB @ 1.2TB/s — "completely obliterated the value economics."

Bargain bin: 4x used GTX 1080 for ~$400 = 32GB VRAM. 6x used Tesla P40 for ~$2K = 144GB.

━━ THE NEW BUDGET MAP

$400 → 4x GTX 1080, 32GB, runs 27B at low bits
$899 → Mac mini M6, 32GB, all-day local agents
~$2,000 → EVO-X2 128GB (the value king right now)
~$3,600 → 5090, fastest 32GB
~$4,700 → DGX Spark, the scene favorite
~$8–9,400 → 2x Spark, 256GB, frontier at home
~$7,500–25,000 → M5 Ultra Mac Studio, up to 512GB

━━ THE SOFT STACK (no longer the bottleneck)

Ollama is dominant and now has a zero-retention cloud. llama.cpp 0.3.0 just shipped. Berkeley's FreeToken runs 2–4x faster than Ollama (753B on 96GB). Unsloth dynamic quants, ExLlamaV3, LM Studio. One-click installers (ODS) and hardware checkers (CanIRunAI) mean normies are in. The only chaos left is 90s-PC-builder style: "somebody changes 3 lines of code and performance jumps 40%."

━━ TL;DR

90 days ago, local AI was "impressive demo." Today, ~$3,000 of hardware matches last year's frontier models on most benchmarks, and $8,000 gets you near-Opus with 1M context at home. The intelligence gap is closed for 27B–100B workloads. Cloud's real moat now is speed-at-scale, >400B frontier, and RAM prices are starting to hurt the CPU/RAM camp.

Watch next: GPT-OSS-2, DeepSeek V5, Kimi K4, M7 Ultra (1.5TB unified), and the new wave of "sell your idle Mac" compute networks.

The permanent underclass is cancelled.

Apparently I’m a “gooner” now because I posted some AI cowboy art featuring attractive men.

Excellent. Add it to my qualifications.

Although, if depicting or appreciating the human body makes someone a gooner, we’re going to need to make some fairly substantial revisions to the history of art.

The ancient Greeks might need to explain all those exquisitely proportioned naked athletes they carved in marble. Michelangelo is going to have an absolutely dreadful meeting with HR over David. Botticelli put Venus naked on a shell and somehow Western civilisation staggered onward. Rubens painted flesh with glorious enthusiasm. Bernini turned marble into bodies so tactile they appear to yield beneath fingertips. Rodin gave us The Kiss. Renaissance painters filled churches and palaces with muscular saints, exposed breasts, beautiful bodies and enough strategically placed fabric to keep art historians employed for centuries.

Then came photography. Cinema. Fashion illustration. Pulp covers. Pin-ups. Comics. Album covers. Digital painting. Fantasy art. Video games. CGI. And now generative art.

The medium changes. Human fascination with beauty, bodies, sensuality, masculinity and femininity does not.

But apparently an adult woman posts a handsome cowboy in 2026 and suddenly some  human on X becomes the Pornography Constable.

It’s particularly funny because reducing every depiction of an attractive human body to masturbation says considerably more about the person doing the reducing than it does about the artist.

Sometimes art is profound. Sometimes it is political. Sometimes it explores sexuality. Sometimes it exists because something is beautiful, strange, funny, provocative or aesthetically delicious.

And sometimes I make hot fucking cowboys because I can.

Art survived the naked Greeks.

I suspect it will survive my cowboys. 🤠

We hope to launch the Verification Age for video models: 50 scientists, 6 months, 100 rule-based verifiers, 300 new tasks, and a worked RL recipe. 

Coding models are advancing crazily thanks to the synthetic RL envs paradigms. Verification via codes or Lean gives models super-human math/coding intelligence like that in Astra and Fable. 

However, video models are still in the GPT-3 stage, where we just dump million hours video data into the model training and hope for magic.

In this work, 
1) we built 100 rule-based verifiers each paired with a synthetic data generators which give 10k+ diverse samples within the task domain 
2) we made additional 300 tasks generators, including classic games i.e. Snake, Gold Miner, Mario, to further scale training data distribution with million samples rendered ready available on HuggingFace 
3)  ~60 experiments to find a worked RL recipe for video model post-training 
4) comparison studies between image models, unified models, video models - which is the best model for visual thinking? 
5) failure modes of how VLM-as-Judge will not satisfy video models RL in long term
6) interpretability studies show all image models, unified models, video models emerged "Schrödinger Effect", CoS reasoning through diffusion steps
7) many more insights

Uno shows a simple way to speed up existing LLMs without changing their output distribution: keep the original model in charge, and use diffusion only to draft multiple tokens in parallel.

Keep the autoregressive model for quality and add diffusion for parallel drafting

On Qwen3-8B, Uno delivered 2.5X higher per-request throughput and 1.6X higher system throughput at the largest tested batch size.

Normal autoregressive LLMs generate 1 token at a time, making long responses, agents, and RL rollouts slow.

Uno adds lightweight diffusion adapters that propose several future tokens at once, while the original model verifies them.

That avoids a separate draft model and preserves the base model’s sampling behavior.

It also sped up end-to-end RL training by up to 40% in the reported runs.
